title: Optimizing Health Related Quality of Life Measurement in Adolescent and Young Adult Oncology
official: Optimizing Health Related Quality of Life Measurement in Adolescent and Young Adult Oncology: A Promising Solution (PROMIS AYA) - Aim 2
summary: This study evaluates how adolescent and young adults with cancer in the U.S. and their loved ones respond to questions that will later be used with people who may have cancer and other chronic health conditions

sites.f: Wake Forest Baptist Comprehensive Cancer Center
